text:
noah: Quick flag 1: ran through the "next-eval-starter" (Next + LlamaIndex) and hit two small but blocking DX problems: (1) sample eval harness shows no embeddings logged, (2) rapid rotate token causes 401s until retries settle. anyone seen this?
aline: I saw the no-embeddings thing locally. The starter's `embedClient` is created with a cached key at module scope, so the eval script that runs multiple cases under different creds never emits events.
dave: I repro the 401 rush. Sequence: start dev, call /api/rotate then immediately hit /api/eval -> first few requests 401 then success after backoff. Logs: `fetch-wrapper: 401 token_mismatch` x3 then `fetch-wrapper: success`.
tori: Starter readme asks people to put RW_KEY in env and restart, but that's terrible for onboarding. We need the starter to work without requiring restarts for rotation tests.
anoah: (typo fix) noah: also worth noting the LangChain adapter sample uses older `createChain` API; parity mismatch with latest SDK agent wrapper might be causing missing telemetry and missing embed events.
aline: I did a quick diff: starter wires embedder via `new RedwoodEmbeddings(process.env.RW_KEY)` once at import. Change to a per-request factory and the harness immediately logs embeddings. Small PR incoming.
dave: For auth, proposed change: fetch adapter should accept a tokenProvider function that reads the latest token from a provider instead of capturing process.env at init. I'll add tests that simulate rotate-token endpoint.
tori: We should also add a tiny e2e job in the eval GH action that posts rotate then runs the eval harness to catch regressions. Node matrix node 18/20 too.
ci-bot: created issue DE-499: "next-eval-starter: embeddings not logged & token stale after rotation" assigned @aline @dave.
aline: PR #210 opened with minimal change: switch embeddings to factory-per-request + unit asserting telemetry.emit('embedding.generated').
dave: WIP branch for tokenProvider. Adding integration test that spins up the starter in CI, posts rotate endpoint, then runs a quick eval that should return 200s with no 401 spike.
tori: temp workaround suggestion for docs: show snippet to recreate client per-request in Next API: ```js
export default async function handler(req, res) {
  const client = new RedwoodClient({ key: process.env.RW_KEY })
  // handle request
}
```
aline: We'll add a small paragraph to README and link DE-499.
dave: Also logging improvement: include `starter.session_id` as opt-in so devs can map logs across steps. Add RW_TELEMETRY_OPT_IN env var.
ci-bot: added label "needs-e2e" to DE-499.
tori: once merged, patch the quickstart template used by get-started so new users don't hit this.
aline: merging PR after test green. will ping here.
noah: thanks y'all 44d closing once both changes landed and quickstart updated.
